question: To whom must the Kaula teaching never be given because of reviling sacred principles?
inference: The teaching must not be given to one who reviles Shiva or slanders Kula Bhairava.
uncertainties: kulabhairave may qualify nindake or stand as a separate object of revilement
plain_english: O Goddess, it must not be given to one who reviles Shiva, nor to a slanderer of Kula Bhairava.
